limitations: Translated source/state/table reconstruction of one diagnostic45 BON column (32 native plus13 upper extensions), not independent spectroscopy or physical optical truth.
Grouped major/minor and identifier component arrays have no retained independent component observer; total comparison does not establish independent component accuracy.
Python vector/scalar/libm operation details may differ from compiled Fortran; gates are numerical source consistency and make no compiled bitwise claim.
No transport/flux attribution, RRTMG spectral equivalence, gpoint pairing, normalization, tuning, observational or whole-port verdict.
Saved GAS_COL_DRY participates only as precheck; reconstruction itself uses held mass/VMR and pinned coefficients.
next_action: No static blocker to one bounded root-owned calculation; terminal result/source mapping/gates require separate saved-output review.

predeclared_gates.reconstructed_tau: finite, nonnegative and exact target zero mask

secondary_expected_metadata_not_used_as_.purpose: Root may compare completed saved result rows after authorized calculation; analyzer does not consume this independent inventory.

source_correspondence.axes: Pinned loader162-164 and frontend/kernels map NetCDF major[temp,pressure,eta,gpt], vmr[temp,gas,atm], minor[temp,eta,contributor] to source internal axes; script explicitly indexes native NetCDF order, verifies recorded dimension names, uses only basic slices.
source_correspondence.flavors: Frontend create_flavor1765-1802 scans band then atmosphere, preserves first occurrence; rewrite only (0,0)->(2,2). Script name remap and first-unique ordering match.
source_correspondence.gas_and_dry_columns: Frontend 1300-1328 packs available gases in coefficient-table order and maps vmr_ref by original name, retaining dry at index0. Script does same, uses standalone grouping mass*avogad/(m_dry*10000), VMRelement*dry, explicit N2 .7808; saved GAS_COL_DRY is only an early control, not a reconstruction input. Frontend608-641 constructs the passed-dry col_gas likewise.
source_correspondence.major: Kernel gas_optical_depths_major385-395 passes jp+itropo to interpolate3D; its one-based k pressure index jpress-1 maps NumPy jp+atm-1 correctly. Four eta/pressure terms in each temperature plane and two col_mix-scaled planes preserve source order.
source_correspondence.minor_reduction: Frontend1971-2088 matches each identifier to gas_minor, filters unavailable gases, subtracts preceding removed contributor widths from start offsets and compacts contiguous slabs. Script asserts original contiguous starts, remapped cursor and final source extent before constructing reduced tables; preserved interval order.
source_correspondence.minor_scaling: Kernel466-498 begins with minor gas column, density scaling .01*Pa/T only when flag set; optional special-gas fraction uses inverse dry col and H2O dry_fact, with exact complement flag. Script conditional arithmetic/order match; coefficient sums four eta/temperature corners, applies scaling and accumulates original imnr order, lower before upper.
source_correspondence.minor_windows: Kernel278-290 uses top_at_1 and masked MINLOC/MAXLOC. Script uses same first-index extrema and lower/upper regime windows, rejects mixed regime range; source no-layer do-loop behavior preserved for this bounded input.
source_correspondence.no_Rayleigh: Pinned retained LW coefficient has no Rayleigh variables and frontend uses absorption branch; script rejects any rayleigh-named coefficient variable. GAS_TAU_RAW is a valid comparison target for this call.
source_correspondence.state_interpolation: Kernel110-169 jtemp/jpress truncation then clipping, residual interpolation fractions, log-pressure regime, eta tiny fallback .5, min(INT(loceta)+1,neta-1), MOD(loceta,1), fminor and fmajor weights match translation. No fraction normalization or opacity clipping.
source_correspondence.target_independence: Saved GAS_TAU_RAW shape checked early but values first used only after tau_major and all filtered minor increments are computed. No target values enter interpolation, contributor/scaling selection or optical-depth construction.
